# HLA Inform: A Classic Quest

Local Z5 R1/050715 is byte-identical to the archive Inform port. Archive matches game and guide identity. Guide gives no version/serial or port designation. Linked source HLAinform.zip describes HLA Adventure 3.20 and Inform port version 0.3, July 2005; these are different version axes, not the Z-machine release number. No rebuild or runtime compatibility proof.

Complete the main Dragon Quest and require the actual GameWon concluding narrative and terminal win. The archived Inform source HLA-objs.inf identifies dragon defeat as the main quest and calls GameWon followed by deadflag=2; HLAinform.inf supplies alternate authored winning narratives. Individual quest credit, other monster kills, experience or equipment are not completion.

Guide is an unsigned combat/quest route, with nine quest annotations and variable combat. Its NPC equipment, food and companion conditions agree with the linked port source, but command-by-command behavior is untested. No exact RNG assumptions or repeated combat as quota filler. Original HLA Adventure and this explicitly selected Inform conversion are one family; do not silently switch binaries.

Family/split proposal: hla-adventure / train. Explicit port of Paul Panks HLA Adventure; group all original/Inform releases and shared-puzzle remakes as hla-adventure. No existing HLA family found. Generic fantasy combat does not establish a relationship with Scott Adams or Zork. Parent review before registry integration.

Use only small broker help excerpts: at most 9 lines / 1000 characters. No complete guide reads, direct guide URL access, or serial excerpts to reconstruct a guide. All story files, full guides, raw transcripts and saves stay central; do not stage them remotely. Help is suggested, not observed game evidence. Resolve startup questions and key pauses first. Save early at a safe ordinary command prompt and at safe milestones; verify actual save success. Menu Enter is an empty command, not a literal space or the word RETURN. On timeout use await_output only: no repeated input, flush commands, keys, restart, new SAVE or waits sent to the game. Collect diverse useful labeled synthetic_probe cases with stated intent and actual same-intent repairs supported by event IDs; no quotas, repeated filler or forced case counts. Use one command at a time near hazards, questions and menus. Keep failures and ordinary deaths labeled as failures. Parent independently verifies the real finale against raw output. Private collection only: game and guide reuse permission remains unknown. No training, evaluation or publication.
